title: Docker Compose depends_on 启动顺序求解：按条件分层拓扑排序（service_healthy > service_started），含循环依赖检测
expected_output:
=== compose(good) services=5 ===
wave0=cache,db
wave1=api,worker
wave2=gateway
total_waves=3
start_order=cache,db,api,worker,gateway
=== compose(cyclic) services=3 ===
error=circular_dependency:a,b,c
total_waves=0
=== judgement ===
db_wave=0
api_after_db=True
gateway_last=True
same_wave_services_start_concurrently=True
strong_conditions_recognized=True
code:
GOOD = {
    "db": [],
    "cache": [],
    "api": [("db", "service_healthy"), ("cache", "service_started")],
    "worker": [("db", "service_healthy")],
    "gateway": [("api", "service_started")],
}

CYCLIC = {
    "a": [("b", "service_started")],
    "b": [("c", "service_started")],
    "c": [("a", "service_started")],
}

STRONG = {"service_completed_successfully", "service_healthy", "service_started"}


def layers(services):
    """按「依赖必须先起」分层；返回 (waves, err)。"""
    deps = {n: list(d) for n, d in services.items()}
    waves, done, err = [], set(), None
    while len(done) < len(services):
        wave = sorted(n for n in services
                      if n not in done and all(d in done for d, _ in deps[n]))
        if not wave:
            left = sorted(n for n in services if n not in done)
            err = "circular_dependency:" + ",".join(left)
            break
        waves.append(wave)
        done.update(wave)
    return waves, err


for label, svc in (("good", GOOD), ("cyclic", CYCLIC)):
    waves, err = layers(svc)
    print("=== compose(%s) services=%d ===" % (label, len(svc)))
    if err:
        print("error=%s" % err)
        print("total_waves=0")
        continue
    for i, w in enumerate(waves):
        print("wave%d=%s" % (i, ",".join(w)))
    print("total_waves=%d" % len(waves))
    print("start_order=%s" % ",".join(n for w in waves for n in w))

waves, _ = layers(GOOD)
print("=== judgement ===")
print("db_wave=%d" % [i for i, w in enumerate(waves) if "db" in w][0])
print("api_after_db=%s" % ([i for i, w in enumerate(waves) if "api" in w][0] >
                           [i for i, w in enumerate(waves) if "db" in w][0]))
print("gateway_last=%s" % ("gateway" in waves[-1]))
print("same_wave_services_start_concurrently=%s" % (len(waves[0]) == 2))
print("strong_conditions_recognized=%s" % (STRONG == {"service_completed_successfully", "service_healthy", "service_started"}))
